notes: TEMPLATE (neutral). Spec for dskit.pipeline.workflow_report, one report per lane. Every section's file, format, row path, title and required flag come from ${report.sections.<name>}; the sources are the step outputs this step reads (its in map), so a changed upstream output reruns the report, and workflow_report refuses when a source no longer hashes to the ledger. step names carry @${T}, the ledger key of this lane.
title: ${report.title}: ${T}

sections.name: data_points_total
sections.title: ${report.sections.data_points_total.title}
sections.notes: One row per ticker: development dates, holdout dates and rows, purged rows (step 3). The holdout is counted here and never evaluated.

sections.name: folds
sections.title: ${report.sections.folds.title}
sections.notes: The rolling-origin fold table: role (warmup or scored), train and validation boundaries, date and week counts.
sections.caption: ${report.sections.folds.caption}

sections.name: data_points_development
sections.title: ${report.sections.data_points_development.title}
sections.notes: Per warm-up fold: panel rows and dates in the fit, calibration (early-stopping) and validation bands.
sections.caption: ${report.sections.data_points_development.caption}

sections.name: data_points_scored
sections.title: ${report.sections.data_points_scored.title}
sections.notes: Per scored fold: panel rows and dates in the fit, calibration (early-stopping) and validation bands.
sections.caption: ${report.sections.data_points_scored.caption}

sections.name: features_rounds
sections.title: ${report.sections.features_rounds.title}
sections.notes: Feature selection: one row per round (family tried, features, score, winner).

sections.name: features_by_family
sections.title: ${report.sections.features_by_family.title}
sections.notes: Final feature count by family; absent when the selection output carries no per-family counts.

sections.name: features_zoo
sections.title: ${report.sections.features_zoo.title}
sections.notes: Model zoo: one row per candidate and variant with its feature count.

sections.name: features_hpo
sections.title: ${report.sections.features_hpo.title}
sections.notes: Hyperparameter search: one row per candidate and variant with its feature count and warm-up skill.

sections.name: losses_development
sections.title: ${report.sections.losses_development.title}
sections.notes: Training, calibration and validation losses per warm-up fold and model, with epochs run and the best epoch (early stopping).

sections.name: losses_scored
sections.title: ${report.sections.losses_scored.title}
sections.notes: Training, calibration and validation losses per scored fold and model, with epochs run and the best epoch (early stopping).

sections.name: loss_metrics
sections.title: ${report.sections.loss_metrics.title}
sections.notes: Frozen-choice scores on the scored folds: wing twCRPS, decision Brier, CRPS and the rest, with equal-cell skill versus the reference.

sections.name: comparisons
sections.title: ${report.sections.comparisons.title}
sections.notes: Paired date-block bootstrap intervals (lo, hi, point) of skill versus each comparison reference.

sections.name: acceptance
sections.title: ${report.sections.acceptance.title}
sections.notes: The preregistered acceptance rule applied to the winner; descriptive only.

sections.name: identity
sections.title: ${report.sections.identity.title}
sections.notes: Identity hashes of the scored stage: config, panel, provenance, inventory, implementation.

sections.name: snapshots
sections.title: ${report.sections.snapshots.title}
sections.notes: Upstream source and snapshot fingerprints the stage read.
